articles.title: Can We Handle the Magnificent 10?
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Can We Handle the Magnificent 10?. Tech banker Storm Duncan made headlines by offering to swap his luxurious California estate for privately held shares of Anthropic. The Claude developer, along with ChatGPT parent OpenAI and xAI owner SpaceX, are preparing for what should be three of the largest-ever initial public offerings. AI-linked companies, from “hyperscalers” to chip makers and power providers, already make up about 45% of the U.S. stock market. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, ANTH.PVT, GOOG, MSFT, SPAX.PVT.

articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Wells Fargo’s Long-Anticipated Wall Street Expansion Is Here. Wells Fargo is finally ready to level up its Wall Street trading business. Trading has been a booming business for the biggest banks in recent years. Revenues of the five largest Wall Street giants across fixed-income, commodities, currencies and equities trading rose more than 15% in 2025.
